title: hydrangea scandens
intro: Hydrangea scandens, commonly known as climbing hydrangea, is a type of flowering vine that originates from China and Japan. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of hydrangea scandens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of hydrangea scandens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic and antiseptic properties.
